tagline: HandBrake's full GUI on a fast Selkies web desktop, GPU-accelerated on NVIDIA, Intel and AMD, with a watch folder that converts on its own.
description: The full HandBrake video transcoder GUI in your browser, running on a hardware-accelerated Selkies web desktop. It is dark by default and uses HandBrake's own native GTK dark mode rather than a repainted theme. Transcoding can run on NVIDIA, Intel and AMD GPUs.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: HandBrake
